sentences.text: Jiuquanornis is classified as a basal ornithuromorph dinosaur, a group that includes modern birds and their close relatives.
Scientists have recorded only a single fossil occurrence of this entire genus.
The genus was first named by Wang, O'Connor, Li, and You in 2013.

Fossils are found in the Early Cretaceous Xiagou Formation of the Changma Basin in Gansu Province, northwestern China. The animal lived between 121.4 and 113.2 million years ago during the Aptian stage.
